# ”Räkna med mer brus och fajt”

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-11-04  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon's main topic is the US midterm results. The Democrats look set to win both the Senate and the House, which caused sharp overnight moves in futures that later calmed. The hosts expect political gridlock, 'more noise and more fighting', and possibly new regulation of data centres in Texas. Earnings coverage was mixed: Ambea, AMD and Cloetta were strong, Volvo's North American truck orders were weak, and Novo Nordisk's report had mixed numbers. A Riksbank rate hike to 2% is widely expected.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 AMBEA — Ambea | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Strong Q3 EBITA of SEK 645m. Margins rose in almost all businesses and Vardaga EBITA grew 25%. Humana deal completed.

#### Reasoning

The hosts called the report strong. Margins rose almost everywhere, and Vardaga EBITA grew 25% on 6% higher sales. The expected Humana deal is done (98% of shares). The hosts stress that Ambea's strength matters because Humana has lower margins. The only weak spot is Validia in Finland, where margins did not improve.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Humana integration dilutes margins more than expected
- if Ambea's core margins stall
- if Finland weakness spreads

> *"Så det tänker jag är riktigt starkt."*

---

### ⛔ VOLV-B — Volvo | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

North American truck orders fell about 45% in October. Goldman cut its target from SEK 380 to 349 and Citi called the figure a disappointment.

#### Reasoning

October truck orders in North America fell about 45% year on year. Analysts are negative: Goldman Sachs cut its target and Citi called the figure a disappointment. The hosts expect this to weigh on the stock today. The negative view comes mainly from the cited analysts.

#### Sell Triggers

- if North American order intake recovers
- if analysts raise estimates again

> *"Och City kallar den här siffran en besvikelse. Det kan tynga aktien i dag."*

---

### 🟠 CLA-B — Cloetta | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Organic growth just over 2% after about zero last quarter. Profit improved and the profitability target was reached ahead of plan.

#### Reasoning

Organic growth returned after a flat previous quarter, profit improved, and the profitability target was reached earlier than planned. The hosts call this positive but give no explicit recommendation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if organic growth returns to zero
- if margins slip back below target

> *"Nämnde vi på Cloetta också att lönsamhetsmålet har uppnåtts tidigare än planerat? Det tänker jag är positivt."*

---

### 🟠 AMD — AMD | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Strong report: revenue up almost 50%, data-centre revenue doubled, stock up 5% after hours.

#### Reasoning

Data-centre revenue doubled and segment profit nearly tripled, which points to continued strong AI demand. Possible data-centre regulation in Texas after the midterms is a risk to the AI trade.

#### Sell Triggers

- if data-centre regulation in Texas spreads
- if AI capex worries return

> *"Det var datacenter där man dubblade omsättningen."*

---
